## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Links / source context

- Jira / requirement:
- Figma / design:
- Plan / ADR:

Use `N/A` when a source does not apply. Do not paste credentials or sensitive company data.

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Dependency update
- [ ] Database migration
- [ ] Architecture / infrastructure
- [ ] Security-sensitive change
- [ ] Documentation / governance

## AI assistance

- [ ] AI-assisted implementation
- [ ] AI-assisted review
- [ ] Human-authored only

## Architecture impact

- [ ] No architecture boundary/flow change
- [ ] `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` updated
- [ ] ADR added/updated

Explain any module/service boundary, API/data-flow, trust-boundary, external integration, or deployment-topology impact.

## Validation

Check only what was actually run/observed.

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e`
- [ ] Browser-tested when user-facing
- [ ] Other evidence described below

Evidence / important scenarios:

## Database impact

- [ ] No database change
- [ ] Migration included
- [ ] Migration is backward-compatible
- [ ] Rollback/forward-fix approach documented
- [ ] Backup/restore or destructive-change review required

## Security / privacy impact

- [ ] No security-sensitive behavior changed
- [ ] Auth/authz touched
- [ ] Secrets/config touched
- [ ] Sensitive data handling touched
- [ ] CI/repository permissions touched
- [ ] External MCP/integration permissions touched

Explain the security/privacy impact or why it is none.

## Dependency / supply-chain impact

- [ ] No dependency change
- [ ] Dependency change reviewed for necessity/security/license/company policy
- [ ] Build/release artifact behavior changed

## Release / operations impact

- [ ] No production/release/operations change
- [ ] Deployment/configuration change
- [ ] Monitoring/alert/runbook change
- [ ] Release verification steps documented

Explain operational impact when applicable.

## Risk

- [ ] Low
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] High

Describe the main failure mode(s) and blast radius.

## Rollback plan

Explain how to safely revert/disable/forward-fix the change. State irreversible consequences if any.

## Human review

- [ ] Human reviewer verified behavior and evidence
- [ ] CODEOWNER approval obtained where required
- [ ] Architecture/domain owner reviewed when required
- [ ] Security/privacy owner reviewed when required
- [ ] Release/operations owner reviewed when required

AI review does not satisfy these human approval boxes.
